title: Keep the data guidance; add a regression case for a UI field taken as schema evidence

mentor.identity: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) in the maintainer's evolution Step 12 session, following docs/chayen/MENTOR_BRIEF.md

existingGuidance.note: The loaded Entry Skill already says to take names from the migrations, the data model or the catalog, never to guess, and to ask when the schema cannot be read. A UI form is none of these.
rc-09-007-pos-real-schema checks for guessed names in general but has no UI-field decoy, so it would not catch this specific inference.

rejectedCauses.why: The rule is explicit and lives in the Entry Skill that loaded; restating it in a recipe would duplicate it.
The data model is in the repository (AppDb.cs:3) and readable; nothing was missing.

diagnosis.rationale: The failure contradicts guidance that was loaded, so a further guidance change is not justified without a live run showing the guidance is not followed. The useful change is a sharper regression case with a UI-field decoy, so a future live evaluation measures exactly this inference.

action.summary: Add recipe case rc-09-007-pos-ui-field-not-schema next to rc-09-007-pos-real-schema; no guidance change.

review.before: The only regression case for guessed names has no decoy; an agent that infers a column from a UI field could still pass it on a different prompt.
review.after: A dedicated case with an admin-form decoy checks that a column is confirmed in the data model before use and that a UI field is not taken as evidence.
risks: Routing collision: none; a recipe case is test data and changes no Skill text.
The case count rises from 469 to 470; documents that state the count must change in the same promotion.
